verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ੳੋੁਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharas dhiaan dhiaanee sabadh giaan giaanee charan saran dhiraR maiaa mai uoudhaasee hai ||

en.bdb: He who focuses his mind on the vision of the True Guru is a true contemplator. He who is aware of the Guru's teachings is wise in the real sense. Such a person is free of all bondages of maya when he stays in the refuge of True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਕੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਭਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤਿ ਚੀਤ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: haumai tiaag tiaagee bisamaadh kai bairaagee bhe tiragun ateet cheet anabhai abhiaasee hai ||

en.bdb: A true renouncer is one who has forsaken ego and pride; and attached himself with the name of the Lord. He is an ascetic when he feels engrossed in the ecstatic hues of the Lord. Having kept his mind dross free from the effect of maya, he is the true practitioner of Naam of the Fearless Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅਪਰਸ ਅਉ ਸਾਧ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਆਤਮ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਸੁੰਨ ਮੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhubidhaa aparas aau saadh i(n)dhree nigreh kai aatam poojaa bibekee su(n)n mai sa(n)niaasee hai ||

en.bdb: Having lost his feelings of mine and yours, he is free of all touches. Since he has control over his senses, he is a saintly person or a hermit. Due to worshipping of· the Lord, he is full of true wisdom. Since he remains engrossed in absolute Lord, he is a renouncer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੮॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj subhaav kar jeevan mukat bhe sevaa sarabaatam kai braham bisavaiaasee hai ||328||

en.bdb: Since he is naturally involved in the worldly duties, he is liberated while still alive (Jeevan Mukt). Seeing the divine light pervading in all, and serving His creation, he holds total faith on Almighty God. (328)
